description: This file defines a utility class 'Gamma' that provides computation methods related to the Gamma functions, including methods like logGamma, gamma, regularizedGammaP, regularizedGammaQ, and special constants and approximations used internally. It is part of the org.apache.commons.math3.special package, indicating its role in numerical calculations within the Commons Math library.

classes.name: Gamma
classes.description: Utility class providing computation methods for the Gamma family of functions, including logarithmic, regularized, and inverse gamma functions, with internal constants and approximations based on mathematical references and algorithms.

methods.name: logGamma
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the Gamma function for positive arguments, using Lanczos approximation for large x and recursion for smaller x.

methods.name: regularizedGammaP
methods.description: Computes the regularized lower incomplete gamma function P(a, x) using series expansion or continued fraction depending on x relative to a.

methods.name: regularizedGammaQ
methods.description: Computes the regularized upper incomplete gamma function Q(a, x) using continued fraction or series expansion depending on the relation between x and a.

methods.name: digamma
methods.description: Calculates the digamma function (psi) using asymptotic expansions for large x and recursion for small x.

methods.name: trigamma
methods.description: Calculates the trigamma function as the derivative of the digamma function, with asymptotic expansion for large x.

methods.name: lanczos
methods.description: Calculates the Lanczos approximation sum for gamma function estimation.

methods.name: invGamma1pm1
methods.description: Computes 1 / Gamma(1 + x) - 1 for -0.5 <= x <= 1.5, based on the NSWC library implementation.

methods.name: gamma
methods.description: Calculates the Gamma function for real x, using reflection for negative arguments and Lanczos approximation for positive arguments.
